Priya Raman Posted on Sep 9

Stop using default exports in large codebases

#javascript#webdev

Default exports look harmless, but they make refactoring harder than it needs to be.

Names drift over time

When a module has a default export, every file can import it under a different name.

import Button from './Button';
import Btn from './Button';

With named exports, your editor can rename the symbol everywhere at once.
